insights.title: V3 ComfyExtension registration pattern for single-node packages
insights.content: A minimal V3 registration module (__init__.py) requires: (1) import SaveTextNode from .nodes, (2) class SaveTextExtension(ComfyExtension) with async def get_node_list(self) returning [SaveTextNode], (3) async def comfy_entrypoint() returning a new SaveTextExtension() instance. No V1 NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS or NODE_DISPLAY_NAME_MAPPINGS. Follows skill_test_nodes/__init__.py reference exactly. A return type annotation on comfy_entrypoint() is a small positive improvement over the reference.

insights.title: OWASP A01 path-traversal risk in subfolder and filename inputs — unmitigated
insights.content: nodes.py execute() has two Medium (OWASP A01) path-traversal risks: (1) subfolder is joined to output_dir without realpath boundary check — fix: os.path.realpath() + assert joined path starts with realpath(output_dir)+os.sep; (2) filename with path separators can escape target_dir — fix: os.path.basename(filename) before constructing full_filename. Neither is Critical/High for local single-user deployments. Both are exploitable in network-exposed ComfyUI (port 8188, no auth). Documented in README.md and api-surface.md but NOT yet fixed in code — scheduled for next plan cycle.

insights.title: Folder-scan counter pattern for ComfyUI output nodes (ImageSaveHelper-style)
insights.content: ComfyUI's ImageSaveHelper pattern for output-file counters: scan target_dir with os.scandir(), compile regex re.compile(rf'^{re.escape(filename)}_(\d+)\.{re.escape(ext)}$'), collect counter values, next_counter = max(counters) + 1 (default 1 if none found). Format counter with zero-padding: str(next_counter).zfill(counter_length). When counter_length==0, skip counter segment entirely and write {filename}.{ext} — this overwrites on every run. OSError from os.scandir is silently caught as a safe fallback (counter defaults to 1). re.escape() on both filename and extension prevents regex injection.

insights.title: Minimal ComfyUI V3 pyproject.toml pattern for zero-dependency packages
insights.content: Minimal ComfyUI V3 pyproject.toml structure: [project] with name, version, description, license (SPDX string), requires-python=>=3.10; [project.urls] with Repository; [tool.comfy] with PublisherId matching the GitHub account name. No [build-system] table needed for custom_nodes installation. No external dependencies — stdlib + ComfyUI builtins only. Follows skill_test_nodes/pyproject.toml reference exactly.
